title: Don't know from where to start
author: InvestmentNew6734
selftext:
Hey I've always wanted to build my own game and thanks to AI it's now possible without learning game dev from scratch, I'm just not sure from where to start I have codex and godot but just giving codex prompt to build things doesn't seem like the Best thing and what I see on here are WAY better results

What's the best workflow to go with if I have codex? Also is godot the issue? Should I go to unreal? Let me know thankssss

comments.author: Evolve_Solo
comments.body: Hey! You’re pretty flexible with this, so just experiment. People usually won’t give you a detailed step by step workflow anyway. There are plenty of videos and Reddit posts with useful information, so search around and try things out. Test different AI models and see which ones you personally find good, and just build your workflow from there.

replies.author: InvestmentNew6734
replies.body:
Wasn't really looking for a detailed step by step just what tools and websites they use to game dev with AI 
But thank you

comments.author: sevenoutdb
comments.body:
just start! what kind of games do you like? What games do you wish had a sequel, or a steampunk version of, what do you want? Think about a mashup of two games you loved, or a a simple arcade game that could be done in a new style, in 3D, or a 3D game done in 2D. have a conversation with Claude/Chat and ask it to iterate on some high level ideas you have. You can build on web (for browser), with is simple, fast, but this can be somewhat limiting versus a more established game engine. Start putting your ideas down. Draw pictures, capture footage from games, movies that are reference/inspiration. 

START
